placements.note: Region-grade site point; the proposed caverns have no published coordinate.
placements.quote: at a depth of 1000 m in the Zinkgruvan mine

total_mass.quote: the 540 kton underground far detector, located at a distance of 360 km from ESS

summary.plain: A planned water tank of 540,000 tonnes, split into two huge caverns a kilometre underground in the Zinkgruvan mine, lined with about 92,000 light sensors to catch neutrinos from the beam.
summary.technical: Two cylindrical caverns (78 m high, 78 m diameter) at 1000 m depth in the Zinkgruvan mine with 540 kt of water, about 92,000 PMTs and 30 % photocathode coverage; 1.2 us time gate for each of the 14 beam pulses per second.

technology.quote: the 540 kton underground far detector, located at a distance of 360 km from ESS. The two detectors are based on the water Cherenkov technique ... single-photon sensitive photomultipliers will be mounted on the walls of these caverns
technology.value: Underground water Cherenkov detector (540 kton) read out by photomultiplier tubes mounted on the cavern walls
